gloss: to bring and share; to each contribute

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {持|も}ち{寄|よ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to bring (something) and share; to each contribute; to pool together
definitions.explanation: When multiple people each bring something to a gathering — food, ideas, money, or resources — to share or combine. Implies a cooperative effort where each person contributes their part.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}ってパーティーをした。
examples.english: We each brought a dish and had a party.

examples.japanese: みんなで{意見|いけん}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}って{話|はな}し{合|あ}おう。
examples.english: Let's each bring our ideas and discuss them together.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{住民|じゅうみん}が{食材|しょくざい}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}って、{炊|た}き{出|だ}しを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Local residents each contributed ingredients and set up a soup kitchen.

notes:
A compound verb from {持|も}つ (to hold/carry) + {寄|よ}る (to approach/gather). Godan verb conjugating as {持|も}ち{寄|よ}らない, {持|も}ち{寄|よ}ります, etc. The key nuance is that multiple people each bring something to a common place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理|りょうり}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to each bring a dish (potluck)
- {意見|いけん}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to bring together opinions
- {資金|しきん}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to pool funds
- {知恵|ちえ}を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る: to pool wisdom

USAGE:
{持|も}ち{寄|よ}り is the noun form, commonly seen in {持|も}ち{寄|よ}りパーティー (potluck party). The pattern ～を{持|も}ち{寄|よ}る always implies that multiple people are participating.
